product_one_liner.value: Nudge provides employers with a personalized financial-wellbeing platform that gives employees timely financial and benefits education and guidance.

pricing_page.notes: The site directs prospects to contact nudge for commercial options rather than publishing a pricing page.

eng_blog.notes: The index shows financial-wellbeing research, industry news and client stories rather than an engineering blog.

public_docs.notes: The site provides a FAQ but no multi-article product documentation portal or developer docs.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The open jobs listed are Strategic Account Executive and Senior Software Engineer; neither is an AI, ML or data-science role.

model_provider.notes: Nudge names its AI as numa but the reviewed public information did not identify the underlying model or provider.

compliance_certs.notes: The page says nudge is accredited with ISO 27001 and operates in line with GDPR.

last_funding.notes: Dealroom lists a March 2021 Series A of £5.0 million; A-Leads reports $6,964,448 for the Series A.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest identified outside round is the March 2021 Series A, before the 18-month window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: A Strategic Account Executive posting is listed as open.

launched_6mo.notes: Nudge announced personalized financial action plans on September 1, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The company announced two U.S. Vice President appointments on October 15, 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: ZoomInfo lists HubSpot in nudge Global’s tech stack.
